abstract: The importance of cell-aggregation during retinoic acid-induced neural differentiation of embryonal carcinoma cells was studied on the PCC-7 cell line. These cells were chosen as they display low tendency for spontaneous aggregation, and they develop preferentially to neurons upon induced in vitro differentiation. Forced aggregation of these cells, in the absence of retinoic acid, did not result in development of neuron- or glial-like cells. Application of retinoic acid prior to or after the cell-aggregation did not result in neural tissue-like differentiation, either. Irreversible induction of neural development was achieved if cell-aggregation and retinonic acid acted simultaneously, and for a period longer than 48 h. Retinoic acid, on the other hand, was found to be toxic on non-aggregated PCC-7 cells. Our data suggest that cell to cell contacts alter the response of these cells to retinoic acid, and their close apposition is a prerequisite for the retinoic acid-induced neural differentiation.
abstract_ja: レチノイン酸による胎児性癌細胞の神経分化において、細胞凝集が果たす役割を検討した。PCC-7細胞株は自然凝集しにくく、レチノイン酸存在下で優先的にニューロンへ分化するため用いた。レチノイン酸非存在下で強制凝集させても、神経様細胞やグリア様細胞への分化は起こらなかった。レチノイン酸を凝集の前または後に投与しても、神経組織様の分化は生じなかった。凝集とレチノイン酸を同時に、48時間を超えて作用させた場合にのみ、不可逆的な神経誘導が達成された。一方、レチノイン酸は非凝集細胞に対して毒性を示した。以上より、細胞間接触がレチノイン酸への細胞応答を変化させ、その密な接着がレチノイン酸による神経分化の前提条件であることが示唆された。
